People would ill-talk if a girl goes to work in the fields

And the boys go to work in the fields, which the girls cannot do; because their parents or husbands do not allow them to do so. Even their parents-in-law restrict them for this; because it is a matter of reputation

it is the responsibility of women to do household chores and working outside is the responsibility of men. If they do work in the other way around, people will malign of them. People will not take this normally.

we have never seen any woman, to grow crops and sell them on her own. It is impossible for a girl because it is a matter of reputation, if she goes in the market, she might be ill-treated by any kind of cheap person, which is why she is not allowed there, by her parents
in the first place she will never even try to do it. She should be crazy to even try. People will never accept that.
I coul not even imagine how people will react.
the men would be angry. I am sure even in the market, they would not buy from her.
They may think that she is a thief. Or she must be somebody her husband and whole family have abandoned because of some bad things.
its not good for young girls to work at market and sell her products
If [female spouse] went to the market to sell the crops, [male spouse]?s respect in the society would decrease, his reputation would decrease.
he will ask her where are you spending your days, where do you learn such disobedience?
If she refuses to give him the income thats the end of their marriage.
He may even becoming violence and starts thinking that she saw someone else.
Women are not daring that she will do such thing.

Because [female spouse] sells vegetables by herself in the market, she will not have any honor in the society

what is the reason to going to market to sell vegetables when [female spouse] has her husband at home? This means she is a bad woman. People will think like this about her
They will think that she is having some hidden affair with someone
People will hate her.
They will even spread some unfounded stories about her.
The neighbors would not want to associate themselves with her.
a man under his wifes wing is the weakest and controlled type.
he is not a man.

older women will say stuff like she has no control over her husband etc

Mary will be blamed by people for this ironic situation in her family
some people take it negatively and say [female spouse] is roaming around in market leaving children and husband at home.
very bad reputation
Stigma of bad characters
Will be considered very awkward
[female spouse] will be regarded as a bad woman.
People will give negative comments.

[if his wife sells vegetables in the market] [male spouse]?s respect would lessen amongst his village and friends. People will talk trash.
A lot of them would say, ?How could [male spouse] allow his wife to do men?s work outside??

To the friends and the other people of the village,  [male spouse] will not have any respect as well. They will see him as a mean person. And they will say Why do you send your wife to the market? Why do you not go there?
he will be pressured by both men and women.

no one will ever respect him. They will say she has made him bring water, and take care of the children and he must be so weak that he allowed such a thing.

be careful. Do not associate yourself with him.

No one respected him.
they will call him names or fight with him for no reason.

his friends gossip that he is bad model for our wives

the neighbors gossip that she will leave him sooner

Mark will a laughing stock

people might call [male spouse] Gay

selling small amount of vegetable in the market is a shame for the man.
all will laugh at him and insult him; no one will buy from him.

Then, after they have returned to the village, people now suspect whether they are making an illegitimate relation with any other village boy.
no one respect girls in any case, even family members will tell her to find her own ways

girls who returned from XX with nothing some are mentally ill people feel sorry some gossip.
They think that she is not nice person.
These types of girls are not respected in our community

what they fear is that others will say some bad things about the daughter and she would be unable to get married
There are boys who would wait girls on the road and try to harass them, so our parents are afraid people will see their daughter with them.
What is the point in going if boys will embarrass us by passing lewd comments at us
many people will criticize behind her back and she may lose her social dignity and respect in front of society if she freely moves in the field and public places.
he will be in trouble and an be beaten by the man.

[female spouse] has inferior social position and dignity in the village because she goes to the local market where she sells her products.

she will lose her dignity fully.

they said she is a thief. She is robbing him off what is supposed to be his.

people would say that she is not a good wife

People will make fun of such a family where husband sits at home while wife works outside

If a woman goes outside to work and sell in-spite of having a husband then people say she has a bad character

it is unfathomable if the husbands chooses to sit at home

People will make fun of the whole family
Even women will laugh at her

In case of her participation in market activities, people will blame her husband and consider it bad and no respect for him in the community.
[female spouse] will be regarded as a bad woman.
If the women living in our surrounding villages visit a market, the people talk about them in a bad way.
They think that their husbands or males are shameless who get market work done by their women.
[female spouse]'s  prestige will be considered bad.

Mark is also losing his social status and dignity in the village. His friends make jokes about him and his reputation will be in stake. Many friends may not say their bad comments in front of him but behind him they will do so. He must lose his respects (somman harabe) from others

he is a kind of foolish and unwise person
label him as lazy one and is a woman who cant decide over his life.
he is like a property not a man.

overpowered by a woman; chores are womans job
they will call him women

Mark will be delighted as she is successful in her initiative. We think Mark is surely a lazy husband. So, his reaction will be a positive one to her initiatives.

if he is a man then he supposes to be sorrow
she is controlling him and household
group laughed: happy when wife brings money?

reach home early to be safe from rape and violence from her husband.
woman is not considered pious if she does so
the woman who does this is not considered a good woman.
women do not go to field to work because in that case people will say that she is a bad woman. No man wants people to tell that his wife is a bad woman

if his wife focus only on  her work and stop giving him children, that would be the beginning of the end.
the husband will get more wives but to stop him, the wife keeps on giving birth, and will therefore not be as successful.
his family would tell him, that she is getting more than what he does. And she will soon start treating him like a slave
he will feel inferior to her and act like a man.
his friends may advice him that her income increases and your income is not because you are staying at home and he may be influenced and argue with her
there is also the fear that people will say negative words about the woman.
If she get robbed or raped, there is no one who would understand her, she will be blamed for going out or dressing up

Yes, people think she is looking for some fun

woman cannot sell things easily in the local market because people do not see this positively and criticize the woman doing so. They say that she has become a bad woman. And it creates bad reputation for the family.

immediately she stops getting more children, the man is going to marry another women because she is no longer giving him children.

taboo for men to sell vegetables
